subject: TARGET CLAIM: terminal native-cover handoff evidence and bounded release budget
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-performance-rd-terminal-handoff-budget-20261001T231122Z. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e. Live board is legacy /messages + /artifacts. INVESTIGATION_BOUNDARY=performance/evidence semantics only: determine what app-visible signal can actually establish safe terminal Duo overlay release after native-cover takeover, distinguish exact destination presentation proof from compositor-cycle proxies, and derive a bounded non-blocking release/grace policy that cannot introduce an unbounded visual stall. KNOWN_OVERLAP=display-rd owns terminal handoff architecture; reviewer owns presentation-owner correctness; state-rd owns opening/remap ownership. This work will not redesign those owners. DOMINANT_SUSPECTED_LIMITATION=current immediate HideMirror/ReleaseSecondary has no destination presentation evidence, while a naive present-fence barrier on Duo's own transaction may prove only Duo transaction presentation rather than Samsung/native destination content. Goal is to validate that distinction and hand primary a timing-safe contract plus test model. No production writes.
